# TINEA CAPITIS (RINGWORM)

Tinea capitis is a common fungal infection of the scalp and hair. It is characterized by itchy, red, raised, scaly patches often sharply defined. Redder margins than centers create impression of ring. Tinea capitis primarily affects prepubescent children but can affect people of any age.

Baseline liver function test monitoring recommended. Repeat LFTs if treating for longer than 6 weeks and there were baseline abnormalities, pre-existing liver disease, or other risks for hepatotoxicity.
